profile.name: Ismail Abbasi
profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer | Node.js · React · AWS

summary: Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 6+ years building SaaS products that cut costs and grow revenue for businesses in the US, Australia and Pakistan. Turns slow, manual or expensive operations into fast, automated systems — AI call agents, real-time platforms and cloud infrastructure on Node.js, React, Rust and AWS. Leads projects from the business problem to a live, reliable product.

experience.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer

bullets.text: Lead development of client SaaS products end-to-end with Next.js, React, Node.js and TypeScript, shipping features weekly from architecture to production.
Replaced manual client workflows with AI automation (OpenAI, LangChain), saving client teams 20+ hours per week.
Moved infrastructure to Terraform-managed AWS with Docker and GitHub Actions, cutting hosting cost 30% and making every release zero-downtime.

experience.intro: Lead engineer for client SaaS products, owning architecture, delivery and cloud cost.

experience.title: Full-Stack & AI Developer

bullets.text: Architected and shipped production-grade AI SaaS applications end-to-end using React, Node.js, and TypeScript — including admin dashboards and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for secure, multi-tenant access.
Built an AI interview bot with OpenAI and n8n that screens candidates automatically, cutting recruiter screening time by 70% and replacing a manual hiring step.
Owned the full AWS deployment lifecycle, using Docker and Nginx to establish CI/CD pipelines that enabled scalable, high-availability infrastructure with minimal manual intervention.

experience.intro: Full-stack and AI developer shipping multi-tenant SaaS and automation products for clients.

experience.title: Backend Developer / DevOps Engineer

bullets.text: Developed and optimized 20+ REST APIs using Node.js/Express, integrating JWT authentication and tuning PostgreSQL/MongoDB queries for performance.
Raised uptime to 99.9% by fixing critical production bugs and hardening 15+ legacy endpoints (validation, rate limiting, secrets), ending customer-facing outages.
Built and standardized CI/CD workflows across multiple projects; containerized applications with Docker and Docker Compose to reduce environment inconsistencies.
Configured networking, DNS, SSL, and Nginx/Apache infrastructure for production and staging; implemented centralized monitoring and logging to improve uptime and incident visibility.

experience.intro: Backend and DevOps engineer responsible for APIs, CI/CD and production reliability.

experience.title: Backend Developer

bullets.text: Sped up backend REST APIs and database queries for a healthcare SaaS used by care facilities, so staff got patient data faster in daily care workflows.
Implemented secure authentication flows and data-integrity safeguards, supporting compliance and reliability standards required for handling sensitive healthcare-adjacent data.
Built real-time communication features using WebRTC, enabling low-latency audio/video connectivity within the platform's care-coordination workflows.
Built an end-to-end in-house meeting app with MediaSoup for WebRTC connection management.

experience.intro: Remote backend developer in a distributed team building a healthcare SaaS platform.

projects.name: MoviesHunter
projects.subtitle: Data Streaming Platform — Cloud Infrastructure & Delivery
projects.description: Problem: videos loaded slowly and server bills grew with every new viewer, so users left. Fix: moved video delivery to a global CDN and added caching. Result: pages 60% faster, 40% lower database cost, and the platform grew to 50,000 users without new servers.

bullets.text: Led architecture and a 3-engineer team for a video streaming platform serving 10,000–50,000 active users; S3 + CloudFront CDN cut stream load times by 60%.
Managed a catalog of 50,000+ movies and web series, with metadata, search indexing, and access-control logic scaled for fast discovery and playback.
Designed data architecture across a 2TB+ datastore spanning session/presence, access control, and release metadata.
Deployed containerized Node.js services on EKS with HPA autoscaling; ElastiCache (Redis) reduced database load by 40%.
Provisioned all infrastructure with Terraform (VPC, ASGs, RDS, CloudFront) and GitHub Actions blue-green deploys, holding 99.9% uptime with zero-downtime releases.
Added serverless media processing with AWS Lambda on S3 events for automated uploads, resizing, and format conversion.

projects.name: Trackese
projects.subtitle: Pay-Per-Call Routing & Tracking Platform
projects.description: Problem: the client lost paid phone leads because calls were routed slowly and buyers could not see what they paid for. Fix: built real-time routing and live tracking. Result: every call reaches the right buyer in under a second, and buyers trust the reports, so they spend more.

bullets.text: Sole architect of a dual-microservice platform: a Node.js/Fastify core service paired with a Rust/Actix Web call-processing service on Tokio for concurrent, low-latency call handling.
Engineered real-time call routing with a Redis-first decision layer (sub-50ms routing decisions) and Kafka event streaming to sync routing config across services without downtime.
Scaled to 20,000+ tracked calls per day with per-campaign attribution, buyer caps, and live revenue reporting for publishers and buyers.
Set up observability with Prometheus and Grafana, cutting incident detection time from hours to minutes.

projects.name: Q-up.ai
projects.subtitle: Inbound and Outbound Call Automation SaaS
projects.description: Problem: the business paid a team of callers to answer and chase leads, and missed calls after hours. Fix: built an AI agent that answers, qualifies and follows up 24/7. Result: thousands of calls a month handled with no extra staff, and no lead goes unanswered.

bullets.text: Led backend development of an AI call automation platform handling inbound and outbound calls — call handling, lead qualification, and follow-ups without human agents.
Engineered a type-safe backend with TypeScript, Prisma ORM, and PostgreSQL, enabling zero-downtime schema migrations and consistent multi-tenant data.
Orchestrated OpenAI conversation flows and n8n workflows that automate 5,000+ calls per month across client campaigns.
Built campaign scheduling, retry logic, and call analytics dashboards that give clients real-time outcome reporting.

projects.name: Axiomra EMS
projects.subtitle: Employee Activity & Screen Monitoring System
projects.description: Problem: managers of remote teams could not see who was working or late, and paid for hours not worked. Fix: built live attendance, screen view and session recording. Result: payroll matches real work hours and managers spot problems the same day.

bullets.text: Architected a real-time workforce monitoring platform with a Rust (Axum) backend, React 19 admin dashboard, and Electron desktop agent.
Built live screen streaming and session recording over WebSockets, with chunked uploads and indexed storage for fast playback by employee and date.
Implemented heartbeat-based session tracking that detects app closure, network loss, or shutdown and marks sessions interrupted, keeping attendance data accurate.
Designed shift scheduling with grace periods and live status (checked in, late, offline) across the whole workforce, containerized with Docker.

projects.name: Hostrif
projects.subtitle: Browser Automation & Testing Platform
projects.note: Closed-source commercial tool — not publicly available
projects.description: Problem: the client's teams ran hundreds of browser tasks by hand, which was slow and error-prone. Fix: built a desktop platform that runs and manages browser sessions automatically. Result: work that took a team days now runs unattended, cutting labor cost.

bullets.text: Architected a browser automation platform across three coordinated engines — a Rust launcher, a Python/Playwright engine, and a Node.js/Puppeteer engine — managed from one Electron desktop app with SSE real-time logging.
Wrote custom C++ patches for Chromium's Blink and net/ layers, including RFC 1929 SOCKS5 username/password authentication and profile-driven browser configuration.
Built a proxy infrastructure validating 600 candidates at 120-concurrency with latency scoring, geo-IP resolution, and a local SOCKS5 auth relay.
Designed multi-tenant RBAC on Supabase with JWT auth, invite-link signup, admin impersonation, and audit logging.
Shipped as a cross-platform Electron app (Windows/macOS/Linux) with auto-updater and offline Ed25519 license verification.

certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate — Amazon Web Services - 2024
education: Bachelor of Science, Computer Software Engineering — University of Arizona | 2017 – 2020

approach.text: Find the business problem and the number that proves it is fixed.
Pick the simplest architecture that meets scale, cost and deadline.
Ship small, tested increments with CI/CD so value lands every week.
Track uptime, speed and cost with monitoring, and report results.
Remove bottlenecks and automate manual work as usage grows.
